chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as the exclusive attribute of Divine perception, distinguishing it from human limited views. This aligns with the Shia theological emphasis on *Adl* (Divine Justice), affirming that God’s essence and actions are purely good, free from any hidden defect or evil. The narration serves as a foundation for the believer’s *Tawakkul* (trust), encouraging a perspective that sees all decree as ultimately beneficial within the broader scope of Divine Wisdom.
